description: This file defines the GrainProperties class and related constants and interfaces for managing grain metadata in Orleans, including property representation, well-known property keys, and attribute-based property providers.

classes.name: GrainProperties
classes.description: Immutable class representing properties of a grain, with a method to generate a detailed string representation.

methods.name: GrainProperties
methods.description: Constructor initializing the properties with an immutable dictionary.

methods.name: ToDetailedString
methods.description: Returns a string detailing all key-value pairs in the properties.
